productConcept.name: Griting
productConcept.description: An enterprise AI talent platform that verifies capability through evidence-based evaluation, develops talent through structured learning and mentorship, and connects the AI ecosystem across enterprise, research, and community.
productConcept.rationale: Content was provided verbatim from griting design system — product concept derived directly from page content, not inferred from aesthetic. Griting's brand identity (deep forest green, Helvetica Neue, Inter) is the visual ground truth; still-voltage contributes motion architecture and interaction vocabulary re-mapped to griting's palette.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — still-voltage contributed a substantial motion system (Material Standard cubic-bezier, stagger intensity 3, 17 transition elements). Griting's source had no motion tokens (static Figma extraction). GSAP + ScrollTrigger used throughout.
contentSource: griting verbatim — 4 pages, 32 sections. No copy was reworded.
notes: griting typography (Helvetica Neue) is not web-accessible. Inter is used as fallback. Font fallback comment included in each HTML <head>.
Blog page (blog-index.html, blog-post.html) starts with on-light nav (white bg) since pages begin with light background — no transparent nav needed.

still-voltage motion tokens formed the entire motion system — griting had no motion (static Figma). The merger was additive: griting provided brand identity, still-voltage provided all motion vocabulary.
Testimonial section uses CSS @keyframes scroll animation (no GSAP) — more performant for the continuous carousel pattern.
All image src attributes use .jpeg extension (Higgsfield download format). All video src use .mp4.
